references.text: Describes the actual construction of the bronze grate for the altar, as commanded in Exodus 27:4
Refers to the four bronze rings attached to the four corners of the grate, as commanded
Mentions the bronze altar with its grate as part of the tabernacle furnishings
Continues the description of how the grate was to be placed under the ledge of the altar
Summarizes the bronze altar and its utensils, including the grate, which were made according to the Lord's command
Confirms that the entire altar structure, including the four corners mentioned in the source verse, was executed in bronze as a unified whole.
Highlights the theological function of the four corners mentioned in the construction instructions by showing their role in the atonement ritual.
